newsitem.title: USA: U.S. State Dept warns Americans in Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: U.S. State Dept warns Americans in Kuwait.

text.p: The U.S. embassy in Kuwait on Sunday warned American citizens to exercise particular caution over the next few days in light of reported threats against U.S. interests in Kuwait, the State Department said.
The embassy said it was taking "certain additional security precautions" and urged all Americans to be cautious over the next several days.

It urged Americans to review their security arrangements and avoid predictable movements, vary routes and schedules, be wary of unexpected visitors or packages and inspect vehicles for any sign of tampering.
It also urged U.S. citizens to avoid actions that could draw attention to them and be alert to surveillance and "unusual or overly inquisitive persons or callers."
Any security concerns should be called to the embassy's attention, the embassy said in a public announcement.
A State Department spokeswoman in Washington had no additional information on the reports of threats against U.S. interests.
